title.zh: Intel D270 GPU AI Accelerator–Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X
title.en: Intel D270 GPU AI Accelerator–Up to 480 GB LPDDR5X

current_state.zh: Intel's D-series data center GPU, the D270, is advertised with up to 480 GB of LPDDR5X memory and roughly 1.5 TB/s of bandwidth aimed at AI inference workloads, prompting debate over its multi-GPU scaling and real-world availability.
